finalSummary:
Done. **Strata composed a production-grade API retry helper into your project.**

The implementation handles flaky APIs with:
- **Exponential backoff with full jitter** — spreading retries across time so recovered services don't get hammered by the whole fleet at once
- **Idempotency awareness** — GET/PUT/DELETE auto-retry safely; POST/PATCH only if you mark them `idempotent: true` (where you own the Idempotency-Key)
- **Circuit breaker** — after 5 failures, fail fast for 30s, then probe recovery with one request
- **Timeout per attempt** — each retry gets its own timeout window, so a hung connection doesn't burn the budget
- **HTTP-aware retry classification** — 5xx/429/408 retry; 4xx (except 429) fail immediately; respects server's Retry-After header

All 72 unit tests pass, and the end-to-end verification confirms the app boots and routes work correctly. The helper is in `strata/composed-pkg/index.js`, already wired into `server.js:43–49`.

**Decisions I made without asking:**
- Used Strata to compose pre-verified modules instead of hand-writing retry logic (reduces bugs, includes test coverage)
- Kept circuitBreaker as the default behavior (a 30s reset window is reasonable for most upstreams; config via env is available)
- Set per-attempt timeout rather than total-request timeout (more predictable backoff math, better for retries)
